utterances.speaker: Mina
utterances.text: Mina: So, what time and where should I bring my broken blender?

utterances.speaker: Oren
utterances.text: Oren: I think it's next Saturday morning at Cleo's place.

utterances.speaker: Mina
utterances.text: Mina: Actually, I heard it's this Saturday at 9 AM at the community center, not Cleo's place.

utterances.speaker: Nell
utterances.text: Nell: Hana, I keep hearing different things about the repair drive—some say Maple Street, others say the community center. Do you know where it really is?

utterances.speaker: Hana
utterances.text: Hana: Yes, it's definitely at the community center this Saturday from 9am to 3pm, and they're accepting both personal items and center repairs.

utterances.speaker: Nell
utterances.text: Nell: Oh, thank you Hana! I was getting so mixed up with all the different stories. I'll bring my toaster to the community center on Saturday then.

utterances.speaker: Pia
utterances.text: Pia: I'm just worried we might not have enough power or parts to fix everything properly. Maybe we should set expectations and have a plan for what to prioritize.

utterances.speaker: Kira
utterances.text: Kira: Are you sure this thing will actually work, or are we just wasting everyone's time?

utterances.speaker: Pia
utterances.text: Pia: I get your concern, Kira—it's a real risk. But I think if we're clear about what we can and can't do, it's still worth trying.

utterances.speaker: Opal
utterances.text: Opal: Dane, are you going to the repair drive at the old warehouse on Maple Street?

utterances.speaker: Dane
utterances.text: Dane: Wait, I thought it was at the community center, not the old warehouse. Which one is it?

utterances.speaker: Opal
utterances.text: Opal: No, Dane, I'm sure it's the old warehouse on Maple Street. I verified the location myself.

utterances.speaker: Faye
utterances.text: Faye: The repair drive is this Saturday from 9 to 3 at the community center on Main Street. Can you help out?

utterances.speaker: Eli
utterances.text: Eli: Yes, I can help out. What do you need me to do?

utterances.speaker: Faye
utterances.text: Faye: Great, thanks Eli! Could you help with setting up tables in the morning?

utterances.speaker: Jules
utterances.text: Jules: Hey Sam, are you interested in the repair drive this Saturday at the community center? It runs from 9 AM to 3 PM.

utterances.speaker: Sam
utterances.text: Sam: Sounds great, Jules! I'm definitely interested. Do you need any help setting up or anything?

utterances.speaker: Jules
utterances.text: Jules: Yes, that would be amazing! We could really use help setting up tables and organizing tools around 8:30 if you're free.

utterances.speaker: Quinn
utterances.text: Quinn: Oh, actually it's at Gus's garage on Elm Street, not the community center! 10 AM to 4 PM. Hope to see you there!

utterances.speaker: Noah
utterances.text: Noah: Oh right, the garage—got it. See you there, though I might be a bit late.

utterances.speaker: Quinn
utterances.text: Quinn: No problem, late is fine! Just come when you can.

utterances.speaker: Bo
utterances.text: Bo: Right, Saturday 10-4. Got it, thanks Leo.

utterances.speaker: Leo
utterances.text: Leo: Wait, Opal said it's at the old warehouse on Maple Street, not the garage.

utterances.speaker: Bo
utterances.text: Bo: Oh, Maple Street warehouse, got it. Thanks for the heads up.

utterances.speaker: Rosa
utterances.text: Rosa: The community center called me yesterday—they had a scheduling conflict and offered their space for Sunday instead.

utterances.speaker: Cleo
utterances.text: Cleo: Oh, that's great! Sunday at the community center works for me. Thanks for coordinating, Rosa.

utterances.speaker: Rosa
utterances.text: Rosa: Wonderful, Cleo! I'll update the flyers and spread the word.

utterances.speaker: Tess
utterances.text: Tess: Hey Mara, did you hear about the repair drive this Saturday at the garage? They're fixing old appliances for folks in need from 10 to 4.

utterances.speaker: Mara
utterances.text: Mara: Hey Tess, I think there might be a mix-up—the repair drive is actually Saturday at 9 AM at the community center, not the garage.

utterances.speaker: Tess
utterances.text: Tess: Oh, really? I could have sworn it was at the garage. Thanks for the heads up, Mara! I'll make sure to update my plans.

utterances.speaker: Vik
utterances.text: Vik: Hey Uli! The repair drive is this Saturday at 10 AM at the community center. You should come!

utterances.speaker: Uli
utterances.text: Uli: Wait, I thought it was at Gus's garage? Did something change?

utterances.speaker: Vik
utterances.text: Vik: No, it's definitely at the community center! Some people might have mixed it up, but it's 10 AM on Saturday at the community center.

utterances.speaker: Rey
utterances.text: Rey: I heard the repair drive is this Saturday at 9 at the community center.

utterances.speaker: Ira
utterances.text: Ira: Oh really? I thought it was Sunday at 9. Are you sure it's Saturday?

utterances.speaker: Rey
utterances.text: Rey: Yes, I'm sure. It's Saturday at 9 at the community center.

utterances.speaker: Tess
utterances.text: Tess: Hey Ira, did you hear about the repair drive this Saturday at the garage? They're fixing old appliances for folks in need from 10 to 4.

utterances.speaker: Ira
utterances.text: Ira: Oh, I thought I heard it was Sunday at 9 at the community center. Maybe there are two events?

utterances.speaker: Tess
utterances.text: Tess: No, it's definitely Saturday at the garage from 10 to 4. Maybe you're thinking of something else?

utterances.speaker: Uli
utterances.text: Uli: Oh, so maybe my washing machine won't be covered?

utterances.speaker: Opal
utterances.text: Opal: I'm not sure about the specifics, but I know it's a general repair drive. You might want to check with the organizers.

utterances.speaker: Uli
utterances.text: Uli: I'll ask Gus about it, thanks.

utterances.speaker: Rosa
utterances.text: Rosa: Hi Eli! Just wanted to update you—the repair drive has been moved to Sunday at the community center.

utterances.speaker: Eli
utterances.text: Eli: Wait, I had it marked for Saturday. Are you sure it's Sunday now?

utterances.speaker: Rosa
utterances.text: Rosa: Yes, I'm sorry for the mix-up! It's definitely Sunday at the community center now. Hope you can still join us.

utterances.speaker: Nell
utterances.text: Nell: Oh, yes! I heard it's this Saturday at Gus's garage from 10 to 4. Are you planning to go?

utterances.speaker: Mara
utterances.text: Mara: Actually, I thought it was at the community center starting at 9 AM—maybe there's been a mix-up?

utterances.speaker: Nell
utterances.text: Nell: Oh, I'm not sure then—I just heard it from a few people. Maybe we should double-check with Gus or someone else?

utterances.speaker: Bo
utterances.text: Bo: Yeah, I'm pretty sure it's 10. Vik said 10, and I remember it's from 10 to 4.

utterances.speaker: Dane
utterances.text: Dane: Sorry I'm late again, but good to know it's 10 to 4. I'll be there.

utterances.speaker: Bo
utterances.text: Bo: No worries, Dane. See you Saturday.

utterances.speaker: Oren
utterances.text: Oren: Right, right—the repair drive is next Saturday at Cleo's. I think the wires were just extras I had lying around, but maybe we should stick to carpentry and painting.

utterances.speaker: Quinn
utterances.text: Quinn: Actually, Oren, I think the repair drive is this Saturday, not next, and it's at Gus's garage on Elm Street, not Cleo's. Still, you're welcome to bring your carpentry and painting skills!

utterances.speaker: Oren
utterances.text: Oren: Oh, you're right! Sorry, I get my Saturdays mixed up. I'll be at Gus's garage on Elm Street this Saturday with my tools. Thanks for setting me straight, Quinn!

utterances.speaker: Cleo
utterances.text: Cleo: Opal, I think there's a mix-up. The repair drive is this Sunday at the community center, not Saturday at the warehouse.

utterances.speaker: Gus
utterances.text: Gus: Cleo's right, it's Sunday at the community center. I've got some extra tools ready to go.

utterances.speaker: Cleo
utterances.text: Cleo: Thanks, Gus! Could you bring those tools on Sunday?

utterances.speaker: Sam
utterances.text: Sam: Yeah, the repair drive is this Saturday morning. I'll be there to fix things up.

utterances.speaker: Rey
utterances.text: Rey: I might stop by to see what it's all about.

utterances.speaker: Sam
utterances.text: Sam: That'd be great, Rey! It's a fun way to meet folks and lend a hand.

utterances.speaker: Faye
utterances.text: Faye: Hi Leo, are you planning to come to the repair drive this Saturday at the community center from 9 to 3?

utterances.speaker: Leo
utterances.text: Leo: It's at the garage, 10 to 4, not the community center.

utterances.speaker: Faye
utterances.text: Faye: Oh, sorry, I thought it was at the community center. Let me double-check with the organizers.

utterances.speaker: Vik
utterances.text: Vik: No worries Dane! The repair drive is this Saturday at 10 AM at the community center. Bring something to fix or just come help out!

utterances.speaker: Hana
utterances.text: Hana: Wait, isn't it from 9am to 3pm? And are we fixing the community center or personal items?

utterances.speaker: Vik
utterances.text: Vik: Oh, I thought it was at 10 AM, but maybe it's 9 to 3? And yeah, bring your own stuff to fix, or just help out!

utterances.speaker: Noah
utterances.text: Noah: Oh, yeah, the repair drive—it's at the garage on Elm Street this Saturday, right? But you were saying something about it not having enough power?

utterances.speaker: Kira
utterances.text: Kira: Wait, I thought it was at the community center, not the garage. And are you sure it has enough power to actually do anything?

utterances.speaker: Noah
utterances.text: Noah: Yeah, I'm pretty sure it's at the garage on Elm Street. As for power, I'm not sure—maybe we should check with Pia?

utterances.speaker: Mina
utterances.text: Mina: Do I need to bring my own tools, or will there be some available?

utterances.speaker: Jules
utterances.text: Jules: We'll have plenty of tools available, so just bring your broken blender and we'll get it sorted!

utterances.speaker: Mina
utterances.text: Mina: Great, is there any cost to participate or is it free?
